note: Rules for which model ids name the SAME model, and which lab made a model, for review independence (review/identity.mjs). `same_model` maps a name to the model it is: an effort or thinking variant, a lane or route name, or an alias. `model_lab` declares the lab of models that models.json and lanes.json do not themselves declare. `routes` are vendors that can serve models of several labs: the lab of a model reached through one is never taken from the route. `route_labs` lists the labs a route may be seated for. A cycle opened under pantheon.cycle/v3 carries the whole policy built from these files, so editing them never changes how a recorded cycle verifies.

model_lab_basis.gemini-4-neon: owner direction 2026-11-19: the medium Google implementer on the Antigravity SDK transport (config/antigravity-sdk.json). A Gemini model named by the owner; neither models.json nor lanes.json declares it, so it is declared here: an implementer whose model does not resolve would leave no reviewer eligible.

route_labs_basis: owner direction 2026-11-17: Antigravity serves Gemini models only. A seat on a route vendor is asked, and its answer admitted, only for a model of a listed lab. Contributors are still resolved by model, whatever route reached them.
orchestrators_note: `gemini-pro-orchestrator` and `gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon` (Orchestrator (Carbon)/(Argon)) are NOT declared: the docs describe each as pairing two Gemini 4 models in one conversation (a planner model plus Gemini 4 Hydrogen), so one answer is two models' work and has no single identity. They are unresolved names and cannot be seated.
